pages.text: $(t4)Tier 4$() Mekanism unlocks the apex tech content: $(item)MekaSuit$(), $(item)MekaTool$(), QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production.$(br2)$(bold)MekaSuit:$() The best armor in the pack for tech-path players. Modular, upgradeable, and powerful. Requires extensive Mekanism infrastructure to produce.$(br2)$(bold)MekaTool:$() All-in-one tool replacing pick, axe, shovel, hoe, and sword. Configurable modes. Endgame default tool.$(br2)$(bold)Fusion Reactor:$() Produces enormous amounts of RF. Building one is a $(t4)T4$() capstone project. Powers the late-game Mekanism factory comfortably.$(br2)$(bold)Antimatter:$() Produced via Particle Accelerator. Required for several Mythic infusion recipes and the $(thing)Oblivion's Rift$() portal components.$(br2)$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism Generators and Tools are documented alongside the core mod at $(bold)mekanismmod.com$(). Focus on the Fission Reactor and Fusion Reactor at $(t4)T4$() - both require significant infrastructure.
